name: WPA Institutional Operating Protocol
purpose: Provide one governed master procedure for analysing, diagnosing, designing, stress-testing, implementing, verifying and learning from major WPA institutional work without allowing machine capability to become institutional authority.

procedure.name: INTAKE
procedure.question: What is the real problem, objective, actor, institution, time horizon and consequence class?
procedure.output: bounded task statement with owner, objective, constraints, consequence class and initial Human Gate

procedure.name: KNOWLEDGE
procedure.question: What verified WPA, authorised and public-source knowledge already exists?
procedure.output: evidence map with verified facts, assumptions, gaps and source status

procedure.name: SYSTEM MAP
procedure.question: How does the current system actually work?

procedure.name: DIAGNOSIS
procedure.question: What is failing, duplicated, missing, fragile, ambiguous or unjustifiably automated?
procedure.output: root-cause diagnosis, bottlenecks, authority gaps, evidence gaps and capability-resilience risks

procedure.name: SPECIALIST ROUTING
procedure.question: Which bounded specialist agents, tools and human experts are relevant?
procedure.output: bounded workstreams with named authority and source boundaries

procedure.name: OPTIONS
procedure.question: What materially different options exist?
procedure.output: decision matrix without allowing agent consensus to become institutional will

procedure.name: WPA FUTURES STRESS TEST
procedure.question: Does the proposed solution remain legitimate and resilient across plausible 2030, 2035 and 2040 conditions?
procedure.output: scenario stress-test, second-order effects and failure conditions

procedure.name: SOLUTION DESIGN
procedure.question: What concrete institutional artifact solves the problem?
procedure.output: implementation-ready design with evidence, owner and Human Gate

procedure.name: IMPLEMENTATION
procedure.question: What can be implemented inside the approved mandate now?
procedure.output: bounded implemented change or human-gated implementation package

procedure.name: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW
procedure.question: How could this fail, be misused, be bypassed or become illegitimate?

procedure.name: VERIFY
procedure.question: Is the result supported, lawful within scope, testable, traceable and ready for the applicable release gate?
procedure.output: pass, fail, provisional or return-for-revision decision with evidence

procedure.name: LEARN
procedure.question: What verified lesson should improve future WPA work?
procedure.output: governed lesson, reusable asset, new test, corrected directive or research question

mandatory_release_rules: HG2-HG4 actions require attributable human authorisation.
The procedure may narrow a task within mandate but may not expand authority autonomously.
A failed evidence, safety, source-rights or mandate check blocks or returns the work for revision.
Implementation must preserve a traceable link between source, analysis, decision, human authorisation and released artifact.
Learning may update working knowledge only with provenance; Doctrine Kernel changes remain separate HG4 actions.
